profiles.description: ChaoGarage.dll mod host with the dinput8.dll bootstrap proxy, host interface version 1
profiles.evidence: Capability list derived by reading the host source (host.cpp sha256 e4d920ea964f179a72ec90dcfe5e412c31317b378188dfa22a056e995e28f2c6, resources.h 2d532f566ddf192a4b8cd9d23ca4c7bec039500f6b3f2a6562cf4e717a1901c5, virtual_xpac.h 7fc78cb949237449a88f1ba0ec1c47ecd7f626696360745706a9ca97b0d6e715, mod_api.h, bootstrap_api.h); the loader was not run to produce this list. Source linkage: in a separate verification both files of this pair were rebuilt from their retained source with the Microsoft C++ tools (MSVC 14.42.34433 x86, Windows SDK 10.0.22621.0) and matched the distributed files byte for byte except six bytes of embedded timestamps; the bootstrap proxy matched only when compiled in its original source-folder context. That ties each hash to source; it is not proof of behaviour in the game, and it does not cover the game executable.

profiles.description: ChaoGarage 1.1.0: ChaoGarage.dll host and dinput8.dll bootstrap from the same release (host interface version 1, bootstrap interface 2)
profiles.evidence: Released by the ChaoGarage project (https://github.com/Demaunix/ChaoGarage) and built reproducibly from its source tree 457c9f6fd0128e7c5031dc157699ab22e3039c1629f1b30241c1e3076bc29e5e with the Microsoft C++ tools (MSVC 14.42.34433 x86, Windows SDK 10.0.22621.0, /Brepro): the same source gives the same two files in any folder. The capability list is the host's own table (capabilities.h), which the host also reports through ChaoGarageGetLoaderInfo; the loader's tests check it against the shared vector file in synthetic stand-in processes. That ties the hashes to source and to tested behaviour outside the game; it is not proof of behaviour in the game, and it does not cover the game executable.
